description: Pins an app to the project's UX benchmark. Give competitor_project_id for an app from find_competitors.crawled_apps, or package_name for a Google Play app: FlyTrap then creates a public store project for it and crawls it (10 to 40 minutes, uses crawl quota) before pinning. Needs the "crawl" scope. Ask the user before creating a new store project; pass confirm: true for that case.

confirm.description: Required (true) when package_name would create a new project

name.description: Display name for a newly created store project

package_name.description: Google Play package id, e.g. com.revolut.revolut

name: add_competitor
title: Pin a competitor
